notes: Item records on dab's ZP tables put right by the era's lists (zp-research/loot-evidence.md): forum t301 'ZP Loot Table' (Ronson 2010, the source dab's sets cite) and the Cryptic Souls pages it copies. By name, so it holds on either shard; jibrish's decision on dab's rows. Not made: Rallos's Keeper's Staff and Ceremonial Vestment (t301) share their names with unrelated records here (707116, a level 10 enchanter quest staff; 5192, a level 29 robe), and Life Eternal needs code (a 5-charge use: a massive melee hit, then a saved death).
sql: UPDATE itempattern SET "str" = ?, "sta" = ?, "agi" = ?, "wis" = ?, "dex" = ?, "cha" = ?, "intelligence" = ?, "HPMAX" = ?, "POWMAX" = ?, "PoT" = ?, "HoT" = ?, "AC" = ?, "PR" = ?, "DR" = ?, "FR" = ?, "CR" = ?, "LR" = ?, "AR" = ?, levelreq = 55 WHERE itemname = ?
UPDATE itempattern SET agi = 20 WHERE itemname = 'Trueshot Pendant' AND agi = 10
UPDATE itempattern SET cha = 25, wis = 25 WHERE itemname = 'Honor Guard Totem' AND cha = 20 AND wis = 20
UPDATE itempattern SET equipslot = 14 WHERE itemname IN ('Chosen''s Staff', 'Chosen''s Rapier', 'Chosen''s Baton', 'Victor''s Blade') AND equipslot = 12
